system.longDesc: You can project your will to influence others or as a forceful psychic attack.
system.requirement: Power talent: Willpower (Psychic Projection) power focus at Expert

degree0.desc: You gain two Novice-degree Psychic Projection effects.

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Psychic Projection effect. You also gain the power focus Willpower (Psychic Projection).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Psychic Projection effect. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Psychic Projection effects for –1 SP.
